objective: sum of cost[worker, task] * assign[worker, task]

group.description: Worker group; in each group only an allowed team may work
group.label: worker group

size_capacity.description: Maximum total size of the tasks a worker takes
size_capacity.label: worker size limit

size.description: Size a task uses of its worker's limit
size.label: task size

min_workers.description: Workers the task must be assigned to (at least)
min_workers.label: workers required per task

cost.description: Cost of assigning the task to the worker; a missing row means the worker cannot do the task
cost.label: assignment cost

works.description: 1 if the worker works when this team is chosen for its group
works.label: worker works in the team (0/1)

decision_variables.assign[worker, task]: binary, 1 if the task is assigned to the worker
decision_variables.works[worker]: binary, 1 if the worker has at least one task
decision_variables.team[team]: binary, 1 if the team is the chosen working pattern of its group

constraints.one_team[group]: sum of team[k] over the group's teams == 1
constraints.team_pattern[worker]: works[worker] == sum_k works[k, worker] * team[k] over the teams of the worker's group
